tianxia.talent.puppetry.substitute_harm_.why: The recorded reduction is transferred to the vessel's temporary Hit Points or Hit Points exactly once, and the vessel breaks at 0, for both new and old sealed kits (combat/ext/vessel.py).
covers: The vessel takes the damage that was reduced (its Hit Points drop; it breaks at 0).

tianxia.talent.puppetry.knot_the_knee.why: The reaction is asked on the first step of the marked creature's own move and spends the mark as a Reaction (combat/ext/puppetry_movement.py).
covers: spend the mark as a Reaction

tianxia.talent.puppetry.sleeve_pulling_r.why: A failed Dexterity save makes the Opportunity Attack miss, even on a natural 20, through the documented forced-miss seam (combat/ext/vessel_talents.py); a successful save gives it Disadvantage.
covers: Failed Save: The Opportunity Attack misses.

tianxia.talent.puppetry.threaded_step_fo.why: Moving an active vessel asks for one willing ally within 5 feet and grants that ally 5 feet without an Opportunity Attack from one marked creature, once per owner turn (combat/ext/puppetry_movement.py).
covers: choose one willing ally within 5 feet of it
Use Threaded Step Formation once per turn.
